Hanno Ecotourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-morimana-riverwatch/

Observe creatures living in the Naguri River (Iruma River) in early autumn, enjoy fishing, and learn about the connections between riverside wildlife and water quality indicator species.

【Participation fee】
Adults ¥5,000 / Students ¥4,000 / Preschoolers ¥2,500 (includes guide, insurance, materials, etc.)

【Capacity】
15 people per date

【Guide】
Mori no Field Gakusha (Forest Field School) staff

【What to bring】
Drinks, change of clothes, hat, lunch

【More information】
Mori no Field Gakusha website: https://morinomanabiya168.wixsite.com/website
